calorieRule: TDEE - 15-20% (a moderate deficit that preserves muscle and energy)
habits: Weigh yourself 3-4 mornings per week and track the weekly average — daily fluctuations are noise.
Prioritize protein at every meal to stay full and protect muscle.
Drink water before meals; it measurably reduces calorie intake.
Walk 8,000-12,000 steps daily — low-intensity movement burns fat without raising hunger.
Sleep 7-9 hours — short sleep increases hunger hormones and stalls fat loss.
Limit liquid calories (sodas, juices, sugary coffee) — they do not satisfy hunger.
name: Cut (Lose Fat, Reveal Definition)

training.focus: Full-body strength training to retain muscle, plus 2-3 cardio sessions for the deficit. Every session ends with 10 minutes of walking.
training.split: Upper / Lower split or full-body 3x/week, each muscle group trained at least twice per week.

calorieRule: TDEE maintenance (eat at your total daily energy expenditure)
habits: Keep protein steady — it is the main lever for body composition at maintenance.
Stay consistent with training volume; maintenance still requires progressive effort.
Use the scale and waist measurements to catch slow drift early.
Keep 80% of meals whole and minimally processed; leave 20% flexible.
Prioritize sleep and daily steps — they do most of the quiet work.
name: Maintain (Hold Weight, Improve Composition)

training.focus: Balanced strength training across all major movements with steady progressive overload. Add conditioning you enjoy 2x/week.
training.split: Push / Pull / Legs + Upper, or Upper / Lower split twice per week.

calorieRule: TDEE + 5-10% (a small surplus — lean gains without excess fat)
habits: Eat in a small, consistent surplus — a huge surplus just adds fat.
Hit protein targets daily; they matter more than the surplus size.
Track weight gain at 0.25-0.5% of bodyweight per week — faster means too much fat.
Sleep 7-9 hours — growth hormone peaks during deep sleep.
Be patient: visible muscle takes months, not weeks.
name: Build (Gain Lean Muscle)

training.focus: Progressive overload on compound lifts (squat, hinge, press, pull, row) with 10-15 hard sets per muscle group per week. Limit cardio to 1-2 easy sessions so it does not eat the surplus.
training.split: Push / Pull / Legs / Upper / Lower, or a 5-day body-part split.
